Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space.

- Preparation and management of E2E System Commissioning phase
- Monitoring of System Functional, Operational and Performance status indicators and parameters
- Monitoring of applicable System, Operational and Service KPIs/SLA
- Supervision and Coordination of System level ILS&OPS teams and activities when in Routine phase
- Generation of Service and Operational reports
- Participation to Program, Operational and Engineering milestones, meetings, boards and reviews.
Qualification:Master degree in Electronic, Aerospace, Management Engineering.

- Experience of at least 2 years on:Space Missions Management and Coordination tasks

- Certified knowledge and work experience on the following software technologies:Virtualization technologies
- Cloud Computing
